excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunica

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
向虚境深处探索，我们来到了[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视无可抵挡。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智。在残垣断壁[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们离开后，第一次，感受到了一种此前只记录在有机物种身上存在的虚弱感：饥饿。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意志，[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
texts.en:
Probing deeper into the Shroud, we came within reach of the [Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was overpowering.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left, for the first time, with a weakness we have previously documented only in organic species: hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]
